query: Put together my weekly run recap email
expected_behavior: Routes to the digest capability and reads references/weekly-digest.md
Runs scripts/cache.py status, then scripts/cache.py validate --for digest, and refreshes any missing key by calling the MCP tool the output names and piping the response into scripts/cache.py put
Builds the digest with scripts/digest/run_pipeline.py rather than running the sub-steps by hand or rewriting the analysis
Produces weekly_run_digest.html in the resolved output directory and reports the distance against the rolling goal, the percentage, and the subject line
Surfaces any note: or warning: lines from the pipeline, including which MCP call would fill the gap, instead of dropping that content silently
Hands over the HTML file path and does not claim to have emailed it
Does not hardcode a weekly goal or invent insights that the data does not support
